method: Direct GLB accessor read with numpy; single triangle primitive, no node transforms. No repair, filtering, smoothing, mesh export or file mutation. Index-edge incidence plus exact-position equivalence seam check and vertex-connected component counting.
nearZeroToleranceNote: Twice triangle area <=1e-12 in mesh units squared; faces unchanged.
limitation: Edge watertightness does not establish vertex-manifoldness, self-intersection freedom, local thickness, semantic part separation, source identity, UVs or rigging.
